quality_flags.detail: [mainflow_trigger_continuity] The Trigger restricts the explicit termination path to 'a ballistic missile track', while the Preconditions and Main Flow apply to generic surveillance tracks (Air, Surface/Maritime, Land/Ground, including ballistic missile). A non-ballistic track for which the JU ceases reporting satisfies the Preconditions and has a Main Flow continuation, but no Trigger entry condition in this use case.
